items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I wrote out the trumpet parts and the tenor parts for Henry.

ctx.x: So what kind of a model would you use when you started to do your writing, when you first started to write?

Whatever I heard, I could write. I just had to... Like, Jay taught me the changes on the piano. So I would figure that out, and then I'd write out the instruments for trumpet and tenor. They're all in the same key, so it was easy for me to write them. So I wrote out the trumpet parts and the tenor parts for Henry. It was real easy to do. But without Jay McShann, I don't know what would have happened, because he taught me the changes to most of the tunes that I was trying to write. And I learned all of them, like…
